def num_comm_div(a, b):
    # Find the smaller of the two numbers
    smaller = min(a, b)
    
    # Initialize the common divisor to 1
    common_div = 1
    
    # Iterate from 2 to the smaller number
    for i in range(2, smaller + 1):
        # Check if both numbers are divisible by i
        if a % i == 0 and b % i == 0:
            # Update the common divisor
            common_div = i
    
    return common_div
